name: Yifeng Pharmacy Chain Co., Ltd.
summary: Yifeng Pharmacy Chain Co., Ltd. engages in the retail business of pharmaceutical products in China. The company operates through Retail business and Wholesale business segments. The company offers Western and Chinese patent medicine, traditional Chinese medicine herbal pieces, medical devices and equipment, health supplements and products, personal care products, drugs, and convenience products related to health. It is also involved in chronic disease management, medical project investment, and medical technology development, as well as operates internet hospitals and clinics.
